# 🗜️ 压缩与部署（Compression & Deployment）

> 训练出来的模型是毛坯房，量化、蒸馏、剪枝才是装修队。

这条赛道收录让大模型"住得进显卡"的三条主线：
量化（LLM.int8/GPTQ/AWQ/SmoothQuant）、蒸馏（从 Hinton 到 DistilBERT）、
剪枝（彩票假说到 Wanda），以及与之深度耦合的参数高效微调（LoRA/QLoRA）。

## 奠基与必读

| 论文 | arXiv | 年份 | 一句话贡献 |
| :-- | :-- | --: | :-- |
| Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network | [1503.02531](https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.02531) | 2015 | 知识蒸馏的开山之作 |
| The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis | [1803.03635](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.03635) | 2018 | 中奖彩票假说：稠密网络里藏着可训练的稀疏子网 |
| DistilBERT | [1910.01108](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.01108) | 2019 | 蒸馏进入 Transformer 时代的标志 |
| LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models | [2106.09685](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) | 2021 | 低秩适配：微调只需 0.1% 参数 |
| LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale | [2208.07339](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.07339) | 2022 | 异常通道分解，int8 推理不掉点 |
| GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers | [2210.17323](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.17323) | 2022 | 一次性 PTQ 压到 3-4 bit |
| SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models | [2211.10438](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.10438) | 2022 | 激活异常值迁移到权重，W8A8 平滑量化 |
| SparseGPT: Massive Language Models Can Be Accurately Pruned in One-Shot | [2301.00774](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.00774) | 2023 | 百亿参数一次性剪枝不掉点 |
| QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs | [2305.14314](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14314) | 2023 | 4-bit 基座 + LoRA，单卡微调 65B |
| AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration | [2306.00978](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00978) | 2023 | 按激活幅度保护关键权重，4-bit 推理主流方案 |
| Wanda: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models | [2306.11695](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.11695) | 2023 | 权重×激活幅度的免重训剪枝 |
